quarterly_data.quarter: NXP Semiconductors press release: NXP Trimension Ultra-Wideband Powers BMW Group's Digital (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer BMW Group: NXP's Trimension NCJ29D6 ultra-wideband (UWB) family will be deployed across the BMW Group's fleet, starting with selected 2026 vehicle programs, for UWB-based Digital Key Plus (hands-free car access) and in-cabin presence detection. NXP describes the NCJ29D6 as the first monolithic automotive UWB solution combining secure fine-ranging and short-range radar (a company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: deployment starting with selected 2026 vehicle programs
